params.body:
`elixir.json` declared `https://www.cides.be`, which answers 301 to `https://cides.be`, the site the Astro config itself names as its address. Elixir measured the redirecting host. Same case as ShaneDeconinck/good-governance#22 this morning.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: elixir.json: production is cides.be, the address that answers
